decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north or west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - (6)	The extension to the retail hereby approved shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the retail use of the shop at 11A Devonshire Road

Condition : 6 - It is considered that the proposed demolition of the existing single storey extension and the erection of a new single storey extension and the erection of two-storey side extension to the existing building to create internal access to the first floor flat is acceptable having due regard for the characteristics of the site. The proposal is considered to improve the existing side elevation and residential accommodation and will not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining properties. In this regard, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.3.3, H.4.1, H.6.4 and S.4.7 of The London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan adopted December 2003 and complies with Council's Supplementary Guidance.
description: Demolition of existing rear extension to retail on ground floor and erection of two-storey side and rear extension and single storey rear extension to floorshop and ground first floor flat.
